descriptions.w3d_d15a_angle_messages_80026c40: Angle-limit controller message handler: message 64 forwards to the base handler and initializes on success (else returns 0x80004005), message 66 notifies and forwards; other ids matched against six cached messages save both channel values and set them to -pi/2 and +pi/2, set either limit flag on or off, or forward a queried nonzero value; unmatched messages go to the base handler.
